DOSSIER_ECO <- file.path(DOSSIER_OUT, "data_eco")
CHEMIN_CARREAUX <- file.path(DOSSIER, "france_metro", "carreaux_200m_met.gpkg")

charg    <- readRDS(file.path(DOSSIER_OUT, "modeles_comptage.rds"))

d_mod   <- charg$d_mod
modeles <- charg$modeles
m_p     <- modeles$Poisson

norm_acad <- function(x) {
  x <- tolower(stringi::stri_trans_general(as.character(x), "Latin-ASCII"))
  x <- trimws(gsub("^academie (de |d')?", "", x))
  gsub("[^a-z0-9]", "", x)
}

DEMI_CARREAU <- 100
files_eco <- list.files(DOSSIER_ECO, pattern = "eco_dept_.*[.]parquet$", full.names = TRUE)
centroides <- bind_rows(lapply(files_eco, function(f) {
  read_parquet(f, col_select = c("lcog_geo","x_l93","y_l93","ind")) %>%
    mutate(code_insee = substr(as.character(lcog_geo), 1, 5)) %>%
    filter(code_insee %in% d$code_insee, is.finite(ind), ind > 0) %>%
    group_by(code_insee) %>%
    summarise(x = weighted.mean(x_l93 + DEMI_CARREAU, ind),
              y = weighted.mean(y_l93 + DEMI_CARREAU, ind), .groups = "drop")
})) %>% st_as_sf(coords = c("x","y"), crs = 2154)

CHEMIN_GEO <- file.path(DOSSIER_OUT, "fr-en-contour-academies-2020.geojson")
carte_acad <- st_read(CHEMIN_GEO, quiet = TRUE) %>% st_transform(2154)
cand <- names(carte_acad)[grepl("acad|lib|nom", tolower(names(carte_acad)))]
carte_acad <- carte_acad %>%
  mutate(academie = norm_acad(.data[[cand[1]]])) %>%
  filter(!academie %in% c("guyane","guadeloupe","mayotte","lareunion","martinique")) %>%
  select(academie, geometry)

acad_com <- st_join(st_transform(centroides, st_crs(carte_acad)), carte_acad) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>% select(code_insee, academie) %>% distinct(code_insee, .keep_all = TRUE)

dept2academie <- c(

  "18"="orleanstours","28"="orleanstours","36"="orleanstours","37"="orleanstours","41"="orleanstours",
  "24"="bordeaux","33"="bordeaux","40"="bordeaux","47"="bordeaux","64"="bordeaux",
  "19"="limoges","23"="limoges","87"="limoges",
  "03"="clermontferrand","15"="clermontferrand","43"="clermontferrand","63"="clermontferrand",
  "01"="lyon","42"="lyon","69"="lyon",
  "07"="grenoble","26"="grenoble","38"="grenoble","73"="grenoble","74"="grenoble",

region_academique <- c(
  "clermontferrand"="auvergne_rhone_alpes","grenoble"="auvergne_rhone_alpes","lyon"="auvergne_rhone_alpes",
  "besancon"="bourgogne_franche_comte","dijon"="bourgogne_franche_comte",
  "rennes"="bretagne","orleanstours"="centre_val_de_loire","corse"="corse",
  "nancymetz"="grand_est","reims"="grand_est","strasbourg"="grand_est",
  "amiens"="hauts_de_france","lille"="hauts_de_france",

master <- d %>%
  left_join(df_seg, by = "code_insee") %>%
  left_join(acad_com, by = "code_insee") %>%
  mutate(
    academie    = coalesce(academie, dept2academie[dept]),
    region_acad = factor(region_academique[academie]),
    dept        = ifelse(startsWith(code_insee, "97"), substr(code_insee, 1, 3), substr(code_insee, 1, 2)),
    log_pop     = log(pop_totale),
    log_rev     = log(revenu_moyen_com),
    z_theil     = as.numeric(scale(theil_revenu)),
    z_moran     = as.numeric(scale(moran_I_rev))
  )

cent_pop <- centroides %>%
  mutate(x_pop = st_coordinates(.)[, "X"],
         y_pop = st_coordinates(.)[, "Y"]) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(code_insee, x_pop, y_pop)
master <- master %>% left_join(cent_pop, by = "code_insee")

if (!is.null(d_mod) && "y" %in% names(d_mod)) {
  pred <- tibble(code_insee = d_mod$code_insee,
                 y_obs = d_mod$y,
                 y_pred = fitted(m_p),
                 resid = residuals(m_p, type = "pearson"))
  master <- master %>% left_join(pred, by = "code_insee")
}

colleges <- annuaire %>%
  filter(grepl("^Coll", type_etablissement),
         toupper(coalesce(as.character(etat), "")) == "OUVERT") %>%
  mutate(
    code_insee   = str_pad(as.character(code_commune), 5, pad = "0"),
    secteur      = case_when(statut_public_prive == "Public" ~ "public",
                             grepl("^Priv", statut_public_prive) ~ "prive",
                             TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    sous_contrat = secteur == "prive" & grepl("CONTRAT", type_contrat_prive) & !grepl("HORS CONTRAT", type_contrat_prive),
    hors_contrat = secteur == "prive" & grepl("HORS CONTRAT", type_contrat_prive)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(secteur))

colleges_sf <- colleges %>%
  filter(!is.na(latitude), !is.na(longitude)) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("longitude","latitude"), crs = 4326) %>%
  st_transform(2154)

lire_carreaux_ville <- function(code) {
  st_read(CHEMIN_CARREAUX,
          query = sprintf("SELECT * FROM carreaux_200m_met WHERE lcog_geo LIKE '%s%%'", code),
          quiet = TRUE) %>%
    filter(is.finite(ind), ind > 0, is.finite(ind_snv)) %>%
    mutate(revenu = ind_snv / ind,
           taux_pauv = ifelse(!is.na(men) & men > 0, men_pauv / men * 100, NA_real_)) %>%
    st_transform(2154)
}

recap <- data.frame(
  indicateur = c("Communes", "Population totale", "Collèges privés (total)",
                "Collèges publics (total)", "Communes sans privé (%)",
                "Theil moyen", "Moran moyen", "Exposition riches moyenne",

)
print(recap, row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(top, file.path(DOSSIER_OUT, "top_villes_colleges_prives.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

p <- ggplot() +

inds <- c("theil_revenu","moran_I_rev","exposition_riches","polarisation",
          "part_pop_top10","part_pop_bottom10","getis_ord_riches","segregation_multidim",

  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#b2182b", mid = "white", high = "#2166ac", midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1,1)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 8) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +

  labs(x = NULL, y = "Résidu de Pearson", title = "Résidus par région académique") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
print(p1 + p2)

# ---- Fonction fiche ville ----
fiche_ville <- function(code, save = TRUE) {
  lig <- master %>% filter(code_insee == code)
  if (nrow(lig) == 0) stop("Commune inconnue : ", code)
  nom <- lig$nom_commune[1]
  car <- lire_carreaux_ville(code)
  cols <- colleges_sf %>% filter(code_insee == code)

  p_carte <- ggplot(car) +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = revenu), color = NA) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma", name = "Revenu €/uc") +
    labs(title = paste0(nom, " (", code, ") — carreaux 200 m colorés par le revenu")) +
    theme_void(base_size = 10)
  if (nrow(cols) > 0) {
    p_carte <- p_carte +
      geom_sf(data = cols, aes(color = secteur, shape = secteur), size = 3, stroke = 1.2) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c(public = "#2166ac", prive = "#b2182b")) +
      scale_shape_manual(values = c(public = 16, prive = 18)) +
      labs(color = "Collège", shape = "Collège",
           subtitle = paste0(sum(cols$secteur == "prive"), " privé(s), ", sum(cols$secteur == "public"), " public(s)"))
  }

  inds <- tibble(indice = c("z_theil","z_moran","z_exposition_riches","z_polarisation",
                            "z_part_pop_top10","z_getis_ord_riches","z_segregation_multidim"),
                 valeur = as.numeric(lig[1, c("z_theil","z_moran","z_exposition_riches","z_polarisation",
                                               "z_part_pop_top10","z_getis_ord_riches","z_segregation_multidim")]))
  p_ind <- ggplot(inds, aes(reorder(indice, valeur), valeur)) +
    geom_col(fill = "#6a51a3") + coord_flip() +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey40") +
    labs(title = "Indices de ségrégation (z-scores)", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 9)

  infos <- tibble(champ = c("Population","Revenu moyen","Taux pauvreté","Nb collèges publics",
                            "Nb collèges privés","  dont sous contrat","  dont hors contrat",
                            "Dist. collège public (km)","Privés à 5 km (hors commune)",
                            "Prédiction M4","Région académique"),
                   val = c(format(lig$pop_totale, big.mark = " "),
                           paste0(round(lig$revenu_moyen_com), " €"),
                           paste0(round(lig$taux_pauv_commune, 1), " %"),
                           lig$nb_colleges_publics, lig$nb_colleges_prives,
                           lig$nb_prives_sous_contrat, lig$nb_prives_hors_contrat,
                           round(lig$dist_college_public_km, 2),
                           lig$nb_prives_5km_autres,
                           round(lig$y_pred, 2),
                           as.character(lig$region_acad)))
  p_inf <- ggplot(infos, aes(x = champ, y = 1, label = paste0(champ, " : ", val))) +
    geom_text(hjust = 0, size = 3.2, family = "mono") +
    labs(title = "Fiche commune") + theme_void() + xlim(0, 10) + ylim(0, nrow(infos) + 1) +
    scale_y_reverse()

  p_final <- (p_carte | p_inf) / p_ind + plot_layout(heights = c(3, 1))
  if (save) ggsave(file.path(DOSSIER_OUT, paste0("fig_dashboard_", code, "_", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", nom), ".png")),
                   p_final, width = 14, height = 9, dpi = 150)
  print(p_final)
}

# ---- Fiches des 6 plus grandes villes avec au moins un privé ----
codes_ex <- master %>%
  filter(nb_colleges_prives > 0, !is.na(pop_totale)) %>%
  arrange(desc(pop_totale)) %>% slice_head(n = 6) %>% pull(code_insee)
for (cc in codes_ex) {
  tryCatch(fiche_ville(cc), error = function(e) message(cc, " : ", e$message))
}

# ---- Tableau global ----
vars_tbl <- c("pop_totale","revenu_moyen_com","taux_pauv_commune","theil_revenu","moran_I_rev",
              "exposition_riches","polarisation","part_pop_top10","getis_ord_riches",
              "segregation_multidim","nb_colleges_publics","nb_colleges_prives",
              "nb_prives_sous_contrat","nb_prives_hors_contrat","dist_college_public_km",
              "nb_prives_5km_autres","y_pred")
tab <- master %>% select(all_of(vars_tbl)) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), list(min = ~min(., na.rm=TRUE), q25 = ~quantile(., .25, na.rm=TRUE),
                                     med = ~median(., na.rm=TRUE), moy = ~mean(., na.rm=TRUE),
                                     q75 = ~quantile(., .75, na.rm=TRUE), max = ~max(., na.rm=TRUE))))
tab_long <- tab %>% pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = c("variable", "stat"), names_sep = "_") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = stat, values_from = value) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 3)))
print(kable(tab_long, caption = "Vue globale : distribution des indicateurs sur l'échantillon") %>%
        kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, font_size = 10))
